# GSE60450 source evidence

Complete GEO family XML retrieved 2026-09-10 from
https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE60nnn/GSE60450/miniml/GSE60450_family.xml.tgz.
No samples removed. SHA-256: 294b7fd304e84926d43d4b6d9065fae2a4590110c3e04807a4260cd3f689e7af.

Twelve samples. Series contributor/contact references establish first-seen person order.
The regression checks this order against the XML, without remote enrichment.
